headline_caveats: Adequacy in this slice is decided by exactly one binding hard precondition (ROUTE_NOT_OBSTRUCTED); 2 of 3 declared hard preconditions have an empty violating stratum.

Census C: making INDEPENDENT_VALIDATOR_PRESENT hard drives adequate plans from 32 to 0. The slice registers no per-theorem authority requirement, so the adequate/inadequate split is contingent on that unregistered typing (HC-06).

cases.name: COMPLETE_FAMILY_WITH_UNATTAINED_PRECONDITION
cases.question: Does 'support family complete' imply adequate?
cases.finding: 16 of 34 complete families carry a registered FAILURE that obstructs the producing experiment. They are node-complete and therefore look adequate, but ROUTE_NOT_OBSTRUCTED is unattained.
cases.consequence: DISC-WEB-01 reports theorems_with_a_complete_family=19; the number whose support survives hard preconditions is 13.

cases.name: DERIVED_PREDICATE_MASQUERADING_AS_INDEPENDENT_PRECONDITION
cases.question: Is VALIDATES_EDGE_LOAD_BEARING an independent hard precondition?
cases.finding: No. disc_web_01.py builds the VALIDATES->THEORY edge with load_bearing = (not blocked), so the predicate is definitionally equal to ROUTE_NOT_OBSTRUCTED. Options where they differ: 0.
cases.consequence: Counting it separately would inflate the apparent number of binding preconditions from 1 to 2 on identical evidence.

cases.name: PRECONDITION_EMPTY_NOT_EXERCISED
cases.question: Does every declared hard precondition actually bind on real data?
cases.consequence: An unexercised precondition is decorative: it cannot have caused any adequacy verdict in this slice.

cases.name: FULL_COVER_OBLIGATION_SET_IS_UNSATISFIABLE
cases.question: Can any plan discharge every registered obligation?
cases.proof: Each listed obligation has n_precondition_attained_options = 0, so every choice function over the registered obligations selects at least one option with an unattained hard precondition. No enumeration is needed; the 6 witnesses settle it.
cases.consequence: The slice cannot support the claim 'OSTC T0-T23 is backed by registered execution evidence'. 5 of 24 theorems are unregistered and 6 have only obstructed routes.

cases.name: MUTATION_DISCRIMINATION_HARNESS
cases.question: DISC-WEB-01 deferred this: does perturbing one theorem turn only its own families red?

results.note: Both layers are re-run on the mutated web. Families are keyed on theorem ID through the VALIDATES edge; the theorem's content_sha256 is recorded but never read when deciding support status, so zero movement is a discrimination FAILURE, not a pass.

cases.name: ADEQUACY_CONTINGENT_ON_UNREGISTERED_AUTHORITY_TYPING
cases.question: If INDEPENDENT_VALIDATOR_PRESENT were a hard precondition (spec 6.1: cheaper evidence lacking required authority is not adequate), does the census survive?
cases.consequence: The slice registers no per-theorem authority requirement, so the adequate/inadequate split reported here is contingent on that gap. This is a typing debt, not a licence.
